setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

starting_state: A new empty project that has just started: stopped, Record off, no pattern or output set up. Channel 1 is the selected channel and nothing is held.

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8): the Masks page opens for CH01. Turn E1 one detent. From any page, E1 opens Channel tasks, with the page you came from highlighted, here Masks. The nine tasks, top to bottom, are 1 Masks, 2 Trig params, 3 Output, 4 Clock, 5 Merge modes, 6 Merge Shape, 7 Harmony, 8 Device and 9 History.
steps.title: Open tasks

steps.caption: With the list open, E1 and E2 both scroll it, one row per detent. Turn E1 two detents to row 3, Output, then turn E2 four detents: Clock, Merge modes, Merge Shape, and Harmony, row 7, is highlighted.
steps.title: Scroll down to Harmony

steps.caption: Turn E2 four detents back up the list to Output (row 3), then turn E1 four detents the same way. The highlight stops on Masks, row 1, and the list does not wrap.
steps.title: Scroll back up to Masks

steps.caption: Turn E2 one detent down to Trig params (row 2) and press K3. The Trig params screen opens for CH01.
steps.title: Open Trig params

steps.caption: Turn E1 one detent. Channel tasks reopens with Trig params highlighted, the page you came from, so E1 always brings you back to the task list at your current page.
steps.title: Return to the list with E1

steps.caption: Press K3 to open Trig params again. The header reads TRIG PARAMS CH01.
steps.title: Open Trig params again

steps.caption: Turn E1 to reopen Channel tasks, then turn E2 down to row 9. History, the last row, is highlighted and its value reads OPEN >.
steps.title: Scroll to History (row 9)

steps.caption: Press K3. The History screen opens. Every task in the list opens its own screen this way.
steps.title: Open History

steps.caption: Turn E1 to open Channel tasks from History, scroll up to row 4, Clock, and press K3. The Clock screen opens for channel 1.
steps.title: Open Clock (row 4)

steps.caption: Turn E1 to open Channel tasks again, then turn E2 to row 8. Device is highlighted and its value reads OPEN >.
steps.title: Scroll to Device (row 8)

steps.caption: Press K3. The Device screen opens for channel 1, where its output is chosen.
steps.title: Open Device

title: Find a channel task
